typography.heading: Cormorant Garamond (Google Fonts) - Elegant, premium, high-end travel magazine feel.
typography.sans_heading: Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts) - Clean, modern, highly legible.
typography.body: Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts) - Approachable and professional for UI.
typography.instructions: Import these from Google Fonts in index.css. Replace all instances of Playfair Display with Cormorant Garamond, and DM Sans with Plus Jakarta Sans.

colors.instructions: Replace all existing hardcoded color hexes (like #E25822, #0B4F6C, #FDFBF7, #F9B384, #E8DCC4) with these new variables using Tailwind CSS variables in index.css. Do not leave any hardcoded hex classes.

visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle borders (border-border) with 1px thickness. No heavy borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient, diffuse shadows (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(10,37,64,0.08)]) rather than harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for major cards/images. Pill buttons (rounded-full) for primary CTAs.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) for sticky elements like the navbar and floating chat widget. Never use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays.

layouts_and_grids.bento_grids: For the Trip Detail pages (Expenses, Itinerary) and Dashboard, utilize asymmetric bento grid layouts with varying col-spans. Avoid generic even squares.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 or p-12 in containers instead of tight padding. Allow images to breathe.
layouts_and_grids.hero_section: Full-bleed imagery with a subtle bg-black/30 overlay if text is placed on top. High-contrast typography.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and interactive cards must have hover states (e.g., -translate-y-1, increased shadow, slight color shift).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-transform duration-300 ease-out), NEVER 'transition-all'.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Entrance animations for trip cards (staggered fade-up).

component_instructions.buttons: Pill shaped (rounded-full), bold text, vibrant accent color for primary actions. Muted/Outline for secondary.
component_instructions.cards: Clean, flat cards with subtle borders. If they contain photos, ensure the image fills the top or side entirely without awkward gaps.
component_instructions.badges: Use rounded-full badges for statuses ('unread', 'countdown') with high-contrast text.
component_instructions.navbar: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with a subtle bottom border. Must not be transparent.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Primary CTA text must be pure white (#FFFFFF) against the dark primary or accent colors.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs).

instructions_to_main_agent: Identify all hardcoded color classes in the JSX (e.g., bg-[#E25822], text-[#0B4F6C]) and replace them with semantic Tailwind classes (bg-accent, text-primary).
Update tailwind.config.js to include the new fonts ('Cormorant Garamond' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans') and the new color palette.
Update index.css with the new CSS variables for the color palette, and import the fonts from Google Fonts.
Refine the UI spacing, using larger paddings (p-8, p-12) to match the luxury/editorial travel style.
Implement glassmorphism for the navbar and AI assistant chat widget (Tara).
DO NOT change any application functionality, state management, or backend logic. ONLY modify JSX classes, styles, and config files for the UI.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
